children: How much does it cost to hire an Android app development company?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ff19cf5 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Basic Android applications typically cost $15,000 – $40,000, mid-complexity products range from $40,000 – $80,000, and advanced platforms start at $80,000 and can exceed $150,000. The final development cost depends on application features, system integrations, and security requirements.
How long does it take to develop an Android application?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ab2c7ed e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A basic Android app typically takes 8–12 weeks, while mid-complexity applications require around 12–20 weeks. Enterprise platforms may take six months or longer, depending on integrations, security requirements, and development scope.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-98f1802 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Inceptives Digital provides dedicated Android developers who extend your
, plus complete project teams for end-to-end delivery. Your development scope and internal resources determine which engagement model fits.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-4b43fec e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Hire a freelancer for a limited Android development task with clear requirements.
Choose an Android app development company
when your product needs coordinated design, backend engineering, testing, and ongoing technical support.
Is Kotlin or Java better for Android app development?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ad64974 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Kotlin is the recommended choice for most new Android applications because Google prioritizes Kotlin support and modern
. Java remains practical for maintaining existing Android codebases and legacy integrations.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-f5dd21c e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child
